_comment: Model configuration for Episodic. This file defines available models, their types, and parameters.
_pricing_note: Optional pricing can be added to any model. Format: {"input": 3.0, "output": 15.0, "unit": "per_1m_tokens", "last_updated": "YYYY-MM-DD"}

models.name: gpt-4o-mini
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's efficient small model optimized for fast, cost-effective tasks. GPT-4o Mini delivers impressive quality for its size at a fraction of the cost of larger models. Ideal for high-volume applications where speed and cost matter more than maximum capability.

models.name: gpt-4o
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's flagship multimodal model optimized for speed and efficiency. GPT-4o matches GPT-4 Turbo's intelligence while being 2x faster and 50% cheaper. It excels at complex reasoning, coding, and creative tasks with native vision and audio capabilities.

models.name: o3
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's advanced reasoning model, designed for complex problem-solving that requires deep thinking. Uses chain-of-thought processing to work through multi-step problems, showing its reasoning process. Excels at math, science, and logical puzzles where careful step-by-step analysis matters.

models.name: o4-mini
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's cost-efficient reasoning model. Combines the step-by-step thinking approach of the o-series with a smaller, faster architecture. Great for applications that need reasoning capabilities without the cost of full o3.

models.name: gpt-3.5-turbo
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's legacy chat model that powered the original ChatGPT. Still available for backwards compatibility but superseded by GPT-4o Mini for most use cases. Fast and inexpensive, but notably less capable than newer models.

models.name: gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's instruction-following variant of GPT-3.5. Uses a completion-style API rather than chat format. Useful for specific instruction-following tasks and legacy integrations that rely on the instruct format.

models.name: gpt-5
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: OpenAI's next-generation model representing a major leap in capabilities. GPT-5 brings significant improvements in reasoning, coding, and creative tasks with a massive 272K context window. Designed to handle more complex, nuanced tasks than previous generations.
weaknesses: May be overkill for simple tasks

models.name: gpt-5.1
models.creator: OpenAI
models.description: Incremental update to GPT-5 with refined capabilities and improved reliability. GPT-5.1 addresses early feedback on GPT-5, offering better consistency and reduced hallucinations while maintaining the same powerful feature set.
weaknesses: May be overkill for simple tasks

models.name: claude-opus-4-5-20251022
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: The latest and most capable model in the Opus family. Claude Opus 4.5 represents the pinnacle of capabilities with exceptional reasoning, analysis, and creative writing abilities. Ideal for the most demanding tasks requiring nuanced understanding.
weaknesses: May be overkill for simpler tasks

models.name: claude-opus-4-1-20250805
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: The previous generation Opus model, now marked as legacy. Still highly capable for complex tasks but superseded by Opus 4.5 which offers better value. Maintained for backwards compatibility.

models.name: claude-sonnet-4-20250522
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: A balanced model offering excellent capabilities at a reasonable price point. Claude Sonnet 4 excels at a wide range of tasks including coding, analysis, and creative writing while being more cost-effective than Opus models.
strengths: Great balance of capability and cost
weaknesses: Less capable than Opus for complex tasks

models.name: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: The latest Sonnet model with improved capabilities over Sonnet 4. Offers excellent performance for everyday tasks at a competitive price point. The recommended choice for most general-purpose applications.
weaknesses: Less capable than Opus for complex tasks

models.name: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
models.creator: Anthropic
models.description: The fastest and most cost-effective model in the family. Claude Haiku 4.5 is optimized for speed and efficiency while still delivering solid capabilities. Ideal for high-volume applications and latency-sensitive tasks.

models.name: gemini-2.5-pro
models.creator: Google
models.description: Google's flagship Gemini model with an industry-leading 2M token context window. Gemini 2.5 Pro excels at processing massive documents, long codebases, and extended conversations. Strong multimodal capabilities for text, images, and code.
weaknesses: May be overkill for short tasks

models.name: gemini-2.5-flash
models.creator: Google
models.description: Google's fast, cost-effective model optimized for high-volume applications. Gemini 2.5 Flash offers a 1M token context with excellent speed-to-quality ratio. Ideal for real-time applications and batch processing.

models.name: gemini-2.5-flash-lite
models.creator: Google
models.description: The most cost-effective Gemini model, optimized for maximum efficiency. Flash-Lite provides the cheapest per-token pricing while maintaining a 1M context window. Perfect for cost-sensitive applications and simple tasks.
